props.name: context
props.meaning: The widget context. Every read goes through it, so widgets on a page share one cache.

props.name: entity_types
props.default: Asset, Shot, Sequence, Task, Version, HumanUser, Project
props.meaning: Types to search, with an optional filter each.

props.name: project_id
props.meaning: Scopes every searched type that has a `project` field.

props.name: thumbnail
props.meaning: Field holding the thumbnail URL. `false` hides the leading slot.

props.name: label_field
props.meaning: Field holding the row label.

props.name: sub_label_field
props.meaning: The muted line under the label. A resolved column renders it by type.

props.name: sub_label
props.meaning: The muted line of your own. Wins over `subLabelField`.

props.name: secondary_field
props.meaning: The right-aligned value, drawn by its data type.

props.name: secondary
props.meaning: Right-aligned text of your own. Wins over `secondaryField`.

props.name: show_code
props.meaning: Shows the row's `code` beside the label when the two differ.

props.name: fields
props.meaning: Extra fields to request, so your own sub-label or secondary can read them.

props.name: hotkey
props.meaning: Opens the palette on Cmd/Ctrl+K; a string names another key in place of K.

props.name: inline
props.meaning: Renders a combobox in the page instead of a dialog.

props.name: recents
props.meaning: Rows picked before, newest first, shown on an empty query.

props.name: recent_limit
props.meaning: How many recents survive a pick.

props.name: label
props.meaning: Text on the trigger.

props.name: size
props.meaning: Trigger heights 7, 8 and 9, and the row's leading slot.

props.name: open
props.meaning: Whether the dialog is open.

props.name: placeholder
props.meaning: Text in the search input.

props.name: empty_label
props.meaning: Shown when a query matches nothing.

props.name: loading_label
props.meaning: Names the skeletons a read stands behind, for a screen reader.

props.name: error_label
props.meaning: Shown in place of what the failed read said.

events.name: recents_changed
events.when: The recents list changed, the pick first.

events.name: open_changed
events.when: The dialog opened or closed. Svelte also binds it with `bind:open`.

slots.name: trigger
slots.receives: `{ open }`, a function that opens the dialog. Replaces the default button.

keyboard.does: Opens and closes the palette, when `hotkey` is on; the key `hotkey` names, when it is a string.
Moves through the results, across group headings.
Reaches the trigger; inside the palette focus stays in the input.
Moves the highlight, through a load-more page.
Picks the highlighted row, or loads the next page on the last row.
